prompt:
Style: hand-painted 2D background for a modern side-view adventure game whose characters are animated with 2D skeletal mesh rigs. Painted with textured digital brushes in a matte, slightly gouache-like manner: visible brush strokes, clean simplified shapes with soft edges, gentle stylisation with rounded, slightly leaning forms, moderate detail, calm readable planes. Thin contour lines only where shapes need separating, always in a darker shade of the local colour, never black. Palette: dusty violet, teal blue and slate for sky, sea and shadows, warm amber and orange only for the horizon band and the lights; mid values overall, so that a character painted in front stays readable. Not a photograph, not a 3D render, not a postcard, not pixel art, no paper cut-out look.
Location: the small harbour of Lornholm, a fictional island in a northern sea, at dusk. A stone quay with a short wooden jetty runs along the lower third of the picture. Two small wooden fishing boats are moored at the jetty. On a rocky headland on the right stands a white lighthouse with one red band, its lamp lit. On the left a small stone harbour-master's cottage with a lit window and a smoking chimney. On the quay: two barrels, a stack of crates, a coil of rope and an iron lantern on a wooden post. Calm sea, low clouds, a band of orange light at the horizon, the first stars.
Composition: side view from the eye level of a small character standing on the quay, close to the quay. Flat sea horizon at about 46 % of the image height. The stone quay is a wide, flat, walkable pavement that fills the lower 34 % of the image across the full width; its paving stones are large and calm, and the middle of the quay from 10 % to 75 % of the image width stays completely empty as a walking path. The cottage stands set back on the quay at the left edge, filling the left 22 % of the width, its door about 30 % of the image height tall, the lit window facing the viewer, the chimney against open sky. The iron lantern on its wooden post stands on the quay at about 70 % of the width, its lantern at about 38 % of the image height against the sea and sky. The barrels, the crate stack and the rope coil stand together on the right of the quay, from 78 % to 100 % of the width. Behind the quay, between 25 % and 60 % of the width, the short wooden jetty reaches into the water with the two boats moored at it. The rocky headland rises from the sea on the right behind the props; the lighthouse stands on it at about 86 % of the width, its top at about 14 % of the image height. Keep a margin of plain sky above the top of the lighthouse and the chimney and plain pavement at the bottom edge (the image will be cropped to 16:9). The lighthouse lamp is only a small glowing spot without any beam, there is no smoke from the chimney, no glow halo around the lantern and no birds: beam, smoke, glow and birds are animated separately in the game.
Leave the quay in the foreground free of characters: it is a game background, characters are added later as separate sprites.
No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real places, brands, franchises or recognisable characters from existing games or films.
Image format: landscape 3:2.

Character parts sheet for 2D skeletal mesh animation in a game, painted in the technique of the second reference image (a painted harbour background): textured digital brushes in a matte, slightly gouache-like manner, visible brush strokes, clean readable shapes, gentle stylisation, thin contour lines in a darker shade of each local colour (dark brown, dark green, dark red; never black ink). Soft painted shading in a few value steps, neutral even light from the front-top (the game adds its own lights), no rim light, no cast shadows, no ground. The first reference image is a character sheet: take only the costume, the colours and the proportions from it, not its drawing style and not its layout with three views. Not a 3D render, not plush, not a photograph.
Layout of the sheet: the badger courier seen exactly from the side, facing right. Left third of the image: the complete assembled character standing upright in a neutral pose, both feet flat on one baseline, the near leg slightly in front of the far leg, the far arm hanging down behind the body, the near arm holding the parcel against the side of the body, the loose ends of the scarf hanging down his back. Right two thirds of the image: the same character taken apart into separate pieces for the rig, each piece complete and painted at exactly the same scale as the assembled figure, laid out in a loose grid with clear empty space between all pieces; no piece touches or overlaps another. The pieces: (1) the body: head with cap and ears, the scarf wrapped around the neck, the torso with shirt, vest, satchel strap and satchel, the belly and the short tail, WITHOUT arms and WITHOUT legs; where arms and legs would attach, the shirt, vest and fur are painted complete, with no holes and no cut edges. (2) the near arm: rolled-up cream sleeve, dark furry forearm and paw, holding the parcel tied with string. (3) the far arm: the same arm without the parcel, hanging straight down, a little darker because it is in shadow. (4) the near leg: a short, stout, dark furry leg with a large paw with claws, seen from the side, standing straight, the top of the leg rounded where it goes into the hip. (5) the far leg: the same leg, a little darker. (6) the two loose ends of the red knitted scarf with their fringes, hanging straight down. No labels, no arrows, no guide lines, no frames.
The badger courier: an original mascot character, a stout, short-legged badger with a broad black-and-white striped face, wearing a dark green peaked cap with a brass button, a dark green vest with pockets over a cream shirt with rolled-up sleeves, a long red knitted scarf, a brown leather satchel on a shoulder strap, and a brown paper parcel tied with string under one arm.
All pieces isolated on a fully transparent background.
No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real places, brands, franchises or recognisable characters from existing games or films.
Image format: landscape 3:2.
